zh.description: 这款即时通<RETRO_TM>单个扬声器的功率高达 500 瓦！需要搭配即时通<RETRO_TM>音视频接收器或其他放大器才能使用。
zh.name: 即时通<RETRO_TM>扬声器

en.description: This Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Speaker System with Amp is the all-in-one solution for anyone who wants to listen to their favorite tunes at full volume! Compatible with all KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> headphones.
en.name: Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Speaker System

zh.description: 这款带放大器的即时通<RETRO_TM>扬声器系统是全音量享受音乐的一体化解决方案！兼容所有即时通<RETRO_TM>耳机。
zh.name: 即时通<RETRO_TM>扬声器系统

en.description: Take the show on the road with this amazing Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> DIGITAL Video Camera! Welcome to the future with the world of digital video recording! With an attached polycrystalline-silicon LCD monitor, you'll be the talk of the neighborhood!
en.name: Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Digital Video Camera

zh.description: 带上这款超棒的即时通<RETRO_TM>数码摄像机，随时随地记录精彩瞬间！欢迎来到数字视频录制的未来世界！配备多晶硅 LCD 显示屏，你会成为邻里间的焦点！
zh.name: 即时通<RETRO_TM>数码摄像机

en.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Party needs!
en.name: KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Paper Party Hats

zh.description: 满足你的所有即时用<RETRO_TM>派对的需求！

en.description: File-a-Style<RETRO_TM> pens come in packs of 50, in random assortments of blue and black ink. Variety is the spice of life!

zh.description: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>钢笔一包 50 支，随机搭配蓝色和黑色墨水。多样性才是生活的调味剂！
zh.name: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>钢笔

en.description: File-a-Style<RETRO_TM> pencils come in packs of 100. Sharpeners not included.

zh.description: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>铅笔一包 100 支。不包括卷笔刀。
zh.name: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>铅笔

en.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> pillow needs!
en.name: KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Pillows

zh.description: 满足你的所有即时用<RETRO_TM>枕头的需求！
zh.name: 即时用<RETRO_TM>枕头

en.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> pizza boxing needs! (Note: Pizza not included.)
en.name: KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Pizza Boxes

zh.description: 满足你所有的即时用<RETRO_TM>披萨盒需求！（注意：不包括披萨。）
zh.name: 即时用<RETRO_TM>披萨盒

en.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> plant-hanging needs! Bring a little bit of nature inside.
en.name: KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Hanging Planter

zh.description: 满足你所有的即时用<RETRO_TM>吊挂植物需求！将一点自然元素带入室内。
zh.name: 即时用<RETRO_TM>吊挂式花盆

en.description: Green Gorilla<RETRO_TM> Propane is more than just propane. It's propane in a tank.
en.name: Green Gorilla<RETRO_TM> Propane Tank

zh.description: 绿色大猩猩<RETRO_TM>丙烷罐不仅仅是丙烷。这是装在罐子里的丙烷。
zh.name: 绿色大猩猩<RETRO_TM>丙烷罐

en.description: The ZeViLa Scooticle<RETRO_TM> might seem like it pales in comparison to its bigger sibling the Atomiccycle, but the engineers behind the powerful and popular motorcycle spared no expense when they designed its smaller, city-friendly sibling!
en.name: The Scooticle<RETRO_TM>

zh.description: 泽威拉电动车<RETRO_TM>可能看起来不如它的大哥原子摩托车那么抢眼，但设计了强劲且广受欢迎的摩托车的工程师，也为打造这款适合城市出行的小型机车倾注了大量心血！
zh.name: 泽威拉电动车<RETRO_TM>

en.description: For all your KineBasik<Retro_TM> Assorted Roadsign Needs!
en.name: KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Assorted Roadsigns

zh.description: 满足你的所有即时用<RETRO_TM>各种路标的需求！
zh.name: 即时用<RETRO_TM>各种路标

en.description: File-a-Style<RETRO_TM> Sticky Notes come in packages of 100 in assorted colors.
en.name: File-a-Style<RETRO_TM> Sticky Notes

zh.description: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>便利贴每包 100 张，颜色丰富多样。
zh.name: 文房雅玩<RETRO_TM>便利贴

en.description: The Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> 840 HD TV is the top-of-the-line cathode-ray tube television set, showing all your favorite programs in their beautiful 4:3 aspect ratio!
en.name: Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> 840HD TV

zh.description: 即时通<RETRO_TM> 840 高清电视是顶级的阴极射线管电视，以优美的 4:3 比例呈现所有你最喜爱的节目！
zh.name: 即时通<RETRO_TM> 840 高清电视

en.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> toaster comes with four sets of electrical coils and ten heat settings for that perfect crispy breakfast!
en.name: KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> Toaster

zh.description: 即时烹<RETRO_TM>烤面包机配有四组电热管和十档加热设置，可烹制完美的酥脆早餐！
zh.name: 即时烹<RETRO_TM>烤面包机

en.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> Toaster Oven is perfect for those smaller kitchens or cooking on the go, where a full kitchen isn't available. It's amazing what you can make with it's broil and convection settings!
en.name: KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> Toaster Oven

zh.description: 即时烹<RETRO_TM>小烤箱非常适合小厨房或外出时使用，尤其是在没有完整厨房的情况下。使用它的烧烤和对流功能，你可以做出令人惊叹的美食！
zh.name: 即时烹<RETRO_TM>小烤箱

en.description: The critically acclaimed 'Circle of Comrades' complete series on VHS. 6-Tape Boxed Set.
en.name: "Circle of Comrades" Series on VHS

zh.description: 广受好评的《战友结社》系列录像带。盒装内含 6 盘磁带。
zh.name: 《战友结社》系列录像带

en.description:
A sample of the corrosive substance that Scaldra use to purge Techrot. Handle with care.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Efervon Sample

zh.description:
炽蛇军用来净化科腐者的腐蚀性物质样本。需小心处理。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 艾弗旺样本

en.description:
An Efervon-resistant material used to craft Scaldra uniforms.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Höllvanian Pitchweave Fragment

zh.description:
一种耐艾弗旺的材料，用于制作炽蛇军制服。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 霍瓦尼亚沥青布碎片

en.description:
These curious Techrot growths still quivered in sympathy with Temple’s music long after the gig was over.

Location: Stage Defense missions in Höllvania.
en.name: Beating Heartstrings

zh.description:
即使演出早就结束了，这些奇怪的科腐者生长物仍然随着 Temple 的音乐而舞动。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚的舞台防御任务。
zh.name: 律动心弦

en.description:
This motherboard likely served as a nerve center, facilitating the Techrot's communication network.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Techrot Motherboard

zh.description:
该主板很可能起到了神经中枢的作用，促进科腐者的通讯网络。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 科腐者主板

en.description:
This twisted husk barely resembles the electronic device it once was, consumed and reshaped by the Techrot’s relentless spread.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Techrot Chitin

zh.description:
这个扭曲的外壳已经不再像曾经的电子设备，它被科腐者的无情蔓延所吞噬并重塑。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 科腐者几丁质

en.description:
Höllvanian ingenuity knows no bounds, and this unregulated marvel is proof! A cutting-edge device brimming with untamed innovation.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Experimental Arc-Relay

zh.description:
霍瓦尼亚人的创造力是无穷的，这个不受管制的奇迹就是证明！一款充满狂野创新的尖端设备。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 实验性电弧继电器

en.description:
The Countessa isn't just an icon—she's a hero! Issues from this cult classic comic series are sought after by subculture enthusiasts who know the value of a strong and stylish protagonist. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: The Countessa Comic

zh.description:
伯爵夫人不仅仅是一个偶像——她还是一个英雄！这个经典邪典漫画系列的期刊，深受亚文化爱好者的追捧，他们知道强大而时尚的主角的价值。与莱蒂交换这个六人组宝物，以获取六人组声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 女伯爵漫画

en.description:
The ultimate gift for fans of On-lyne! Show your love and support with this must-have merch for any music lover's collection. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: On-lyne CD

zh.description:
这是送给线上时代粉丝的终极礼物！用这款必备商品来表达你的热爱和支持，它是任何音乐爱好者的收藏品。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 线上时代 CD

en.description:
A set of liquid comfort perfect for anyone who deserves a moment to unwind. Ideal for someone carrying the weight of the world on their shoulders. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Chuggin' Along Sixpack

zh.description:
一套液体放松饮品，非常适合那些肩负世界重担、需要片刻喘息的人。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 酌趣六瓶装啤酒

en.description:
Sleek, stylish, and soothing, mood crystals are the perfect gift for anyone in need of a little calm. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Mood Crystal

zh.description:
心情水晶造型时尚、美观且令人放松，是送给需要冷静一点的人的完美礼物。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 心情水晶

en.description:
A nostalgic treat for the ultimate ‘90s kid! Remember those commercials with the cheerful mouse quartet? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Cheddar Crowns Cereal

zh.description:
这是送给 90 年代孩子的怀旧礼物！还记得那些有欢快的老鼠四重奏的广告吗？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 切达芝士皇冠麦片

en.description:
For the documentarian who sees the world through a unique lens, extra film is always a win. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: 35mm Film

zh.description:
对于对世界有独特视角的纪录片制作人来说，影片越多越好。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 35 毫米胶片

en.description:
Who doesn't like pizza? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Big Bytes Pizza

zh.description:
谁不喜欢披萨？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 超级比特披萨

en.description:
Burgers so tasty they always disappear!

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
en.name: Argon Burger Meal

zh.description:
汉堡美味可口，总是一扫而光！

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）
zh.name: 氩汉堡套餐

en.description:
The manifestation of Thrax's malevolence that shapes the Orowyrms' outbursts.

Location: Rewarded upon defeating the Orowyrm in Duviri
en.name: Pathos Clamp

zh.description:
士魂大帝恶念的显化之物，塑造了奥金魇龙的情绪爆发。

获取地点：在双衍王境击败奥金魇龙后获得的奖励
zh.name: 苦栓

en.description:
Its power lies in its potential.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Tertium

zh.description:
它的力量在于它的潜能。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 三形

en.description:
A whisper of the fallen.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Lamentus

zh.description:
亡者的低语。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 哀灵精华

en.description:
Rune Marrow erupts from Duviri’s core.

Location: The Undercroft in Duviri
en.name: Rune Marrow

zh.description:
密印髓质从双衍王境的核心中喷出。

获取地点：双衍王境地穴
zh.name: 密印髓质

en.description:
Kullervo's fury incarnate. Acrithis will trade this prized artifact for certain items from her collection.

Location: Earned by confronting Kullervo and defeating the Orowyrm in the same Duviri mission during the Fear, Anger, or Sorrow spiral
en.name: Kullervo's Bane

zh.description:
Kullervo 的愤怒化身。可以用这件珍贵的神器与言录使换取她收藏的某些物品。 

获取地点：在恐惧、愤怒或悲伤复眠螺旋中对抗 Kullervo 并在同一个双衍王境任务中打败奥金魇龙
zh.name: Kullervo 的灾刃

en.description:
Duviri citizens plagued by nightmares seek Tasoma, because its stalks can be crushed to create juice that invites pleasant dreams. Unfortunately, it is difficult to forage Tasoma as it only grows in caves.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Tasoma Extract

zh.description:
被噩梦缠身的双衍王境公民们找寻塔苏摩，因为将它的茎压榨后可以制成带来美梦的果汁。但遗憾的是，塔苏摩只生长于洞穴，因此很难被找到。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 塔苏摩萃取物

en.description: A Tasoma fungal spore, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
en.name: Tasoma Spore

zh.description: 一种塔苏摩真菌孢子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。
zh.name: 塔苏摩孢子

en.description:
Duviri citizens harvest Kovnik leaves to blend invigorating teas.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Kovnik

zh.description:
双衍王境的公民们采集福烁草叶子来调配提神茶。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 福烁草

en.description:
Duviri citizens have been known to mash Eevani leaves into a paste that alleviates the discomfort caused by fresh wounds.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Eevani

zh.description:
据说双衍王境的居民会把延凡草的叶子捣碎成糊状，来缓解新伤口引起的不适。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 延凡草

en.description:
The water that courses through Connla Sprouts tastes sweet and refreshing.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Connla Sprout

zh.description:
流经慧泉嫩芽的水尝起来甜美清新。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 慧泉嫩芽

en.description:
The warm light of the Yao Shrub glows even within cold dark places.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Yao Shrub

zh.description:
瑶丛即使在寒冷阴暗的地方也能散发温暖的光亮。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 瑶丛

en.description:
It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Silphsela

zh.description:
传统上认为，看到日精灵瘦果漂浮在空中预示着天空即将发生变化。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 日精灵瘦果

en.description:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Dracroot

zh.description:
龙旋根是魇龙幼体的主食。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 龙旋根

en.description:
Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Ueymag

zh.description:
据说肉麦的肉很好吃。但需小心其倒刺。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 肉麦

en.description:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Saggen Pearl

zh.description:
士魂大帝的战士们使用从慧珠之泉提取出来的重质液体来擦拭他们的武器。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 慧珠

en.description:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience
en.name: Enigma Gyrum

zh.description:
庆祝成功破解双衍王境奥理的纪念物。

获取地点：在双衍历程中完成奥理
zh.name: 奥理刻珠

en.description:
It is said that Aggri Formations are hardened saliva from mighty Orowyrms. Duviri citizens believe Aggristones are powerful talismans.

Location: Duviri
en.name: Aggristone

zh.description:
据说龙涎结晶是来自强大奥金魇龙的硬化唾液。双衍居民们相信龙涎石是强大的护身符。

获取地点：双衍王境
zh.name: 龙涎石

en.description: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
en.name: Inaak

zh.description: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。
zh.name: 载世龟

en.description: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
en.name: Xiran

zh.description: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。
zh.name: 息壤鲳

en.description: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
en.name: Haav

zh.description: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。
zh.name: 浮伤鱼

en.description: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
en.name: Namaes

zh.description: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。
zh.name: 纳土鲉

en.description: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
en.name: Seonn

zh.description: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。
zh.name: 精灵鱼

en.description:
Collectors like to marvel at the peculiar origin of Nacreous Pebbles. Their beauty is the result of ordinary pebbles having been ingested and regurgitated by the Golden Maw.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
en.name: Nacreous Pebble

zh.description:
收藏家们喜欢惊叹于珍珠母石的特殊来源。它们的美丽是普通鹅卵石被黄金喉兽吞食和反刍的结果。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽
zh.name: 珍珠母石

en.description:
Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
en.name: Ariette Scale

zh.description:
每一种双衍王境鱼类都具有与众不同的特征，但它们都进化产生了美丽的彩色鳞片。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽
zh.name: 律光鳞

en.description:
Looks like someone got carried away during a delicious meal.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
en.name: Maw Fang

zh.description:
看起来有人在一顿美餐中被冲昏了头脑。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽
zh.name: 喉兽尖牙

en.description:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
en.name: Temporal Dust

zh.description:
衰变宇宙的尘埃，富含熵。英择谛的研究推测，它正是如噩梦一般的低语者的驱动力。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中从低语者处获得
zh.name: 时光尘埃

en.description:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
en.name: Scuttler Husk

zh.description:
与 Oraxia 战斗留下的残骸，曾经穿着这外壳的蜘蛛已经不见了……然而它的去向不得而知。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中击败 Oraxia 获得
zh.name: 急行蛛外壳

en.description:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw
en.name: Dominus Aureus

zh.description:
被盗的金印，象征双衍王境的王权。归还它们，让士魂大帝重回王位。

可通过在《行动代号：八爪》期间完成双衍王境的《织屿人》任务获得
zh.name: 大帝金币

en.description:
The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Condroc Wing

zh.description:
秃鹰翅膀上的利爪可以伤至见骨。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 秃鹰翅膀

en.description:
Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Cetus Wisp

zh.description:
这些最常出没于夜晚的岩石生命体会被夜灵所触及的海岸线所吸引。它们随时都在夜灵平野的湖泊周围徘徊。它们的起源仍然是个谜。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 希图斯幽魂

en.description:
This hardy fruit is thick-skinned to withstand harsh conditions, concealing a mouthful of sweet pulp within.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Maprico

zh.description:
这种顽强的植物有着坚硬的外皮以抵抗严峻的环境，将饱满的甜美果肉隐藏在其中。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 马利可

en.description:
The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Kuaka Spinal Claw

zh.description:
从库阿卡的脊爪上取得的肌腱，可以晒制成既强韧且具弹性的皮革。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 库阿卡脊爪

en.description:
A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Grokdrul

zh.description:
多醣类与长链聚合物的有毒混合物，葛克度是标准的 Grineer 工业化学材料。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 葛克度

en.description:
A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Iradite

zh.description:
一种对 Ostron 人很有价值的矿物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 伊莱体

en.description:
Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Nistlepod

zh.description:
尼蒐丛用它来困住并杀死猎物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）
zh.name: 尼蒐荚

en.description:
An integral component of Sentient anatomy.  Rarely found undamaged, the specimen may prove useful.

Location: Drops from Vomvalysts on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) at night, and from Sentients found on Lua and the Veil Proxima
en.name: Intact Sentient Core

zh.description:
Sentient 解剖结构中不可或缺的部分。这种难得完好无损的样本可能有重要用途。

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚由轰击使掉落，并且在月球与面纱比邻星域由 Sentient 掉落
zh.name: 完整的 Sentient 核心

en.description:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
en.name: Flawless Sentient Core

zh.description:
这种品质和状态的 Sentient 核心极为罕见。真正的特殊样本。

获取地点：通过捕获在地球夜间的夜灵平野漫游的夜灵获得
zh.name: 无瑕的 Sentient 核心

en.description:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
en.name: Exceptional Sentient Core

zh.description:
令人垂涎的 Sentient 内部解剖样本。这种年份和品质的样本既稀有又珍贵。 

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚中漫游的夜灵
zh.name: 卓越的 Sentient 核心

en.description: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.
en.name: Riven Transmuter

zh.description: 将多个裂罅 MOD 组合起来创造出一个新的不同的裂罅 MOD。
zh.name: 裂罅转换器

en.description:
Torn from the bile duct of a fallen Hemocyte.

Location: Hemocytes found in Plague Star event Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth
en.name: Hemocyte Cystolith

zh.description:
从死亡的免疫血胞体胆管上剥落的物质。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）上的瘟疫之星活动赏金任务中的免疫血胞体
zh.name: 免疫血胞体结石

en.description: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus or to unbind Way-bound focus nodes.
en.longDescription: One of the rarest, most valuable Eidolon shards. Flawless.
en.name: Brilliant Eidolon Shard

zh.description: 通过捕获在夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获得专精点数，或解锁绑定的专精节点。
zh.longDescription: 最稀有、最有价值的夜灵碎片之一。毫无瑕疵。
zh.name: 闪亮的夜灵碎片

en.description: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus.
en.longDescription: A shard of unmatched beauty and power.
en.name: Radiant Eidolon Shard

zh.description: 通过捕获在夜间中徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获取专精点数。
zh.longDescription: 拥有无与伦比的美与力量的碎片。
zh.name: 光辉的夜灵碎片

en.description: Shard gained from the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night.
en.longDescription: The most prized part of an Eidolon. Jewelry created from an Eidolon shard is most prized in Cetus.
en.name: Eidolon Shard

zh.description: 从夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 身上所取得的碎片。
zh.longDescription: 夜灵最具价值的部位。用夜灵碎片制造的首饰在希图斯中价值不斐。
zh.name: 夜灵碎片

en.longDescription: An Eidolon Shard synthesized from Sanctuary study.
en.name: Synthetic Eidolon Shard

zh.longDescription: 通过圣殿研究而合成的夜灵碎片。
zh.name: 合成的夜灵碎片

en.description: A curious blueprint found in the memory banks of Albrecht Entrati's Pom-2.
en.name: Jahu Gargoyle

zh.description: 在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的石榴 2 代电脑系统记忆中发现的奇特蓝图。
zh.name: 形态合成兽像

en.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
en.name: Curse of Knowing

zh.description:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）
zh.name: 认知诅咒

en.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
en.name: Curse of Hearing

zh.description:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）
zh.name: 听觉诅咒

en.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
en.name: Curse of Seeing

zh.description:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）
zh.name: 视觉诅咒

en.description:
A foreboding fragment of the vast Indifference.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
en.name: Grotesque Splinter

zh.description:
巨大虚空无情之物的不祥碎片。

地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）
zh.name: 怪异碎片

en.description:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Shrill Voca

zh.description:
被封印在石头里的虚空语叫声，对解开低语者的秘密至关重要。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 尖锐音魂

en.description:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Echo Voca

zh.description:
虚空语中最安静、最难以捉摸的话语。阿尔布雷希特一直在寻找却从未找到。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 回响音魂

en.description:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Bellow Voca

zh.description:
被刻进石头中的深沉的虚空语哀鸣。意外地成为了一种建造阿尔布雷希特的承载体的资源。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 雄厚音魂

en.description:
During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Entrati Obols

zh.description:
在奥罗金时代，这些小硬币是英择谛家族公认的标志。一些哲士甚至把它们当作幸运护身符。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 英择谛硬币

en.description:
This experimental array transmutes Void energy into high voltages with low currents.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Necracoil

zh.description:
这个实验阵列将虚空能量转化为带有低电流的高电压。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 殁世线圈

en.description:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman
en.name: Entrati Lanthorn

zh.description:
用于将虚空地点映射到真实空间的仪式信标。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）和扎里曼号
zh.name: 英择谛灯笼

en.description:
This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
en.name: Stela

zh.description:
这块虚空之石蕴含着不祥的本质。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）
zh.name: 虚空石块

en.description:
A crucial sub-component in the construction of Albrecht Entrati's vessels.

Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.
en.name: Vessel Capillaries

zh.description:
一个阿尔布雷希特·英择谛承载体建造中的关键子部件。

通过完成火卫二卫城区上的中断任务获得。
zh.name: 承载体毛细血管

en.description:
Eris, carved up and presented to Praghasa in bite sized chunks.

Obtained from Infested nodes on Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound.
en.name: Moonflesh

zh.description:
被切成小块献给「布拉喀萨」的阋神星。

在《划时代行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》期间，从阋神星上的 Infested 节点获得。
zh.name: 月华脯

en.description:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
en.name: Scintillant

zh.description:
这些罕见的奥罗金时代的悬浮遗迹，仍旧监视着火卫二地底深处的隔离库。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）
zh.name: 闪烁体

en.description:
Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
en.name: Pustulite

zh.description:
半成型的不完整孢子载体，只是一个会用利爪固定自己的抽搐着的肉块。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）
zh.name: 脓刃爪疱

en.description:
A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
en.name: Ganglion

zh.description:
一团由缠绕在一起的神经纤维、无用器官以及感官薄膜组成的簇体。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）
zh.name: 神经节囊

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 外壳

en.description:
The damaged remains of a Necramech supporting frame.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift, and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Casing

zh.description:
殁世机甲支撑框架的残骸，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲 外壳

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 引擎

en.description:
An engine designed for use in a Necramech. Unfortunately, it's damaged.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Engine

zh.description:
为殁世机甲设计的引擎。遗憾的是，它处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲 引擎

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 机舱

en.description:
A modular component for a Necramech. It's damaged and in need of repair.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Pod

zh.description:
殁世机甲的模块组件。它处于损坏状态，需要修复。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲 机舱

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲 武器舱

en.description:
A broken weapon system intended for a Necramech.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Pod

zh.description:
为殁世机甲设计的武器系统，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲 武器舱

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪管

en.description:
The damaged barrel of a heavy-duty Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Barrel

zh.description:
重型殁世机甲武器的枪管，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪管

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪机

en.description:
A broken frame that can be used in the construction of a Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Receiver

zh.description:
可以用来构建殁世机甲武器的框架部件，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪机

names.zh: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪托

en.description:
The fractured back portion of a large Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
en.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Stock

zh.description:
大型殁世机甲武器的后部，处于断裂状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金和奥秘隔离库赏金、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
zh.name: 损坏的殁世机甲武器 枪托

en.description: Casing component for the Voidrig Necramech.
en.name: Voidrig Casing

zh.description: 虚空锐将殁世机甲的外壳组件。
zh.name: 虚空锐将 外壳

en.description: Engine component for the Voidrig Necramech.
en.name: Voidrig Engine

zh.description: 虚空锐将殁世机甲的引擎组件。
zh.name: 虚空锐将 引擎

en.description: Capsule component for the Voidrig Necramech.
en.name: Voidrig Capsule

zh.description: 虚空锐将殁世机甲的机舱组件。
zh.name: 虚空锐将 机舱

en.description: Weapon Pod component for the Voidrig Necramech.
en.name: Voidrig Weapon Pod

zh.description: '虚空锐将'殁世机甲的武器舱组件。
zh.name: 虚空锐将 武器舱

en.description: Casing component for the Bonewidow Necramech.
en.name: Bonewidow Casing

zh.description: 骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的外壳组件。
zh.name: 骨骸寡妇 外壳

en.description: Engine component for the Bonewidow Necramech.
en.name: Bonewidow Engine

zh.description: 骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的引擎组件。
zh.name: 骨骸寡妇 引擎

en.name: Bonewidow Capsule

zh.description: 骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的机舱组件。
zh.name: 骨骸寡妇 机舱

en.name: Bonewidow Weapon Pod

en.description:
A spatial orientation matrix to aid with a mechs' guidance, balance and movement.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 1 Isolation Vault Bounties
en.name: OROKIN ORIENTATION MATRIX

zh.description:
一个用来辅助机甲制导、平衡，以及移动的空间定位矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 1 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人
zh.name: 奥罗金定向矩阵装置

en.description:
A cognition matrix that enables mechs to be adaptable and efficient in the field.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 3 Isolation Vault Bounties
en.name: OROKIN ANIMUS MATRIX

zh.description:
一个让机甲在战场上具备适应性和高效率的认知矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 3 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人
zh.name: 奥罗金战意矩阵装置

en.description:
A mech matrix that assists with the machine's weapon accuracy and control.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 2 Isolation Vault Bounties
en.name: OROKIN BALLISTICS MATRIX

zh.description:
一个用来辅助机甲武器精准度和操控性的机甲矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 2 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人
zh.name: 奥罗金弹道矩阵装置

en.description:
These orbs have long since fulfilled their original function, but still, thrum with faint power.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
en.name: Lucent Teroglobe

zh.description:
这些球体早已完成了它们最初的使命，但它们依然剩下微弱的能量。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）
zh.name: 泰罗光球

en.description:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.
en.name: Volatile Motes

zh.description:
由纯能量组成的高度带电粒子。这些粒子是翠玉之光及 Jade 力量的来源，帕尔沃斯·格拉努为了他的翠玉卓越者项目非常渴求这些粒子。

通过完成行动扬升任务（天王星的布鲁图斯）和《行动代号：兽之腹》的特殊行动警报获得。
zh.name: 不稳定微粒

en.description:
Remnants of Jade's light. Echoes of her power.

Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.
en.name: Vestigial Motes

zh.description:
Jade 之光的残留。她力量的回响。

通过完成天王星布鲁图斯节点上的扬升任务获得。
zh.name: 残存微粒

en.name: ARCHON SHARD

zh.description: 一种反熵辐射来源，用于强化合成生命体，尤其是执刑官和战甲。
zh.name: 执刑官源力石

en.description:
The ragged remnants of hopes and dreams can be recreated with patient persistence.

Obtained by completing Follie's Hunt missions on Vesper Relay and Nightmare missions during Operation: Atramentum.
en.name: Nightmare Tatters

zh.description:
希望与梦想的残缺碎片，终能通过耐心与坚持重获新生。

通过在《行动代号：墨痕》期间完成 Vesper 中继站的 Follie 的狩猎任务和噩梦任务获得。
zh.name: 噩梦残片

en.description:
This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth.

Obtained from Atramentum Balloons and completing Follie's Hunt missions (Vesper Relay). Exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay.
en.name: Atramentum

zh.description:
这种深黑色的墨水拥有揭示隐藏真相的力量。

通过墨痕气球，以及完成 Follie 的狩猎任务获得（Vesper 中继站）。前往任意中继站，在见习仲裁者左巴处使用墨痕兑换物品。
zh.name: 墨痕

en.description:
The passionate heat of flames fuels the path to redemption.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
en.name: Ignia

zh.description:
炽热的火焰点燃了救赎之路。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。
zh.name: 热火核

en.description:
A core of rage, jealously guarded in a burnished shell.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
en.name: Maphica

zh.description:
愤怒的核心，被小心翼翼地守护在光洁的外壳之下。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。
zh.name: 怒火核

en.description:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
en.name: Ren Hypercore

zh.description:
这是指节使进化后的核心，承载着其真正自创的名字和身份。当 Tau 花粉供给中断时，这个核心就容易被强制重编程。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：指节使'任务中获取。
zh.name: 人格超核

en.description:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)
en.name: Lyroic Bridge

zh.description:
一种精妙的外神经接口，使经过适当进化的 Sentient 飞行员能够像操控第二层皮肤一样操控庞大的英魂统使。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：英魂统使'任务中获取。
zh.name: 抒情桥

en.description:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
en.name: Ascaris Prime

zh.description:
由执行者 Ballas 开发的技术，可对被劫持的战甲进行短时间的远程操控，迫使他们违背自己最深层的本能行事。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：先锋'任务中获取。
zh.name: 蛔虫 Prime

en.description:
A mark of identification carried by soldiers during The Old War so that their names might be remembered if they never returned home.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
en.name: Agnovidisc

zh.description:
这是远古之战时期士兵携带的身份标记，以便在他们无法返回家乡时，人们能够记住他们的名字。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。
zh.name: 名盘

en.description:
Awarded by Grand Carnus Roathe in recognition of valorous deeds past and present.

Obtained from Perita Rebellion (Dark Refractory) and Operation Alerts during Operation: Blood of Perita.
Exchange with Roathe after completing The Old Peace Quest.
en.name: Marks of Valiance

zh.description:
由总司令罗瑟授予，以表彰其过去和现在的英勇事迹。

可通过《行动代号：佩里塔之血》期间的佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）和行动警报获得。
完成《旧日和平》系列任务后，可用来与罗瑟兑换。
zh.name: 英勇徽章

en.description:
Medals awarded to Orokin soldiers during The Old War for acts of distinguished service.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
en.name: Servoris

zh.description:
在远古之战期间授予奥罗金士兵表彰杰出功绩的勋章。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。
zh.name: 军功勋章

en.description:
Awarded to soldiers during the The Old War for distinction in battle.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
en.name: Laudavi

zh.description:
远古之战期间授予在战斗中表现优异的士兵的物品。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。
zh.name: 荣誉勋章

en.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Crisma Toroids by defeating the Profit-Taker Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
en.name: Crisma Toroid

zh.description:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的利润收割者圆蛛来获取圣油环型装置。
zh.name: 圣油环型装置

en.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Lazulite Toroids by defeating the Exploiter Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
en.name: Lazulite Toroid

zh.description:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的剥削者圆蛛来获取天蓝环型装置。
zh.name: 天蓝环型装置

en.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Calda Toroids from enemies located at the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis and from Scyto Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
en.name: Calda Toroid

zh.description:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷升华实验室内的敌人那里和赛托蛛形机那里获取告达环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。
zh.name: 告达环型装置

en.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
en.name: Vega Toroid

zh.description:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷航天站内的敌人那里和微螨蛛形机那里获取维加环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。
zh.name: 维加环型装置

en.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Sola Toroids from enemies located at the Temple of Profit in the Orb Vallis and from Kyta Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
en.name: Sola Toroid

zh.description:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷润盈殿内的敌人那里和凯塔蛛形机那里获取索拉环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。
zh.name: 索拉环型装置

en.description:
A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
en.name: Thermal Sludge

zh.description:
地球化改造过程中渗流之塔的一种副产物。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）
zh.name: 热能软泥

en.description:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
en.name: Gyromag Systems

zh.description:
一种可以在各种 Corpus 系统中调节纬度和高度的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得
zh.name: 陀螺磁抵系统

en.description:
A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
en.name: Atmo Systems

zh.description:
一种可以抵消在始源星系中遇到的许多大气条件的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得
zh.name: 大气系统

en.description:
Anti-gravity system that allows massively heavy objects to be manipulated by a single user. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
en.name: Repeller Systems

zh.description:
反重力系统可以让一名使用者单独操控沉重的物件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得。
zh.name: 斥极系统

en.description:
A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
en.name: Mytocardia Spore

zh.description:
一种真菌体，因其用途广泛而备受推崇。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）
zh.name: 心肌菌孢子

en.description: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.
en.name: Orokin Monitor

zh.description: 这些奥罗金设备会在漂浮的冰川撞击地面时出现。它们的目的未知。
zh.name: 奥罗金监视机

en.description:
The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
en.name: Gorgaricus Spore

zh.description:
这种山谷巨大菌类的生殖孢子由于其包含的复杂化合物而令人垂涎。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）
zh.name: 葛嘉里菌孢子

en.description: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.
en.name: Frostcap

zh.description: 由奥罗金设计将大气中的化学物质转化为可呼吸的空气。
zh.name: 霜冠

en.description:
The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
en.name: Tepa Nodule

zh.description:
这些植物上色彩斑斓的结瘤在寒冷的环境中发出明亮的光辉。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）
zh.name: 缇帕瘤

en.description:
A unique variant of Thrax Plasm harvested during Void Conjunctions on Lua.

Location: Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua
en.name: Lua Thrax Plasm

zh.description:
一种独特的凶魂浆质变体，可在月球上的虚空联结期间收获。

获取地点：月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus
zh.name: 月球凶魂浆质

en.description:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Entropic Eximus in Zariman missions.
en.name: Entropic Kuva

zh.description:

en.description:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox
en.name: Ferment Bladder

zh.description:
许多火卫二的鱼类会在类似囊状的器官中分泌液体来产生挥发性气体，从而实现短暂的悬浮。

来源：通过在殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
墓沼隐龙
倒刺蒂鳌
高额异鳍
针刺长鳄
狍鸮胶蛳
zh.name: 发酵鱼鳔

en.description:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid
en.name: Tubercular Gill System

zh.description:
自适应膜可使许多火卫二的鱼类在液体和气体环境之间自由移动。

来源：在殁世幽都（火卫二）中的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
独角米索鳎
韧铠灵鲷
zh.name: 管状鳃系统

en.description:

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
en.name: Benign Infested Tumor

zh.description:
异变感染体感染了火卫二上的所有鱼类，连那些看起来没有任何变异的鱼也感染了。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从魔胎之境鱼类中切割获取。
zh.name: 良性感染肿瘤

en.description:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Pustulent Cognitive Nodule

zh.description:
感染导致了多个看似多余，且类似大脑的簇状物的生长，其功能可能与巢群活动有关。 

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和墓沼隐龙中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺、在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面上捕捉墓沼隐龙。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和偌利佐尔感染包囊掉落。
zh.name: 脓疱感知结节

en.description:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Dendrite Blastoma

zh.description:
在 Infested 的身体部位中可以检测到其他生命形态的组成元素，例如这种明显属于陆地动物的寄生组织。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌。此外它还会从魔胎之境的斯蒂亚感染包囊掉落。
zh.name: 树状胚细胞瘤

en.description:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Saturated Muscle Mass

zh.description:
环境污染与 Infested 细胞变化，这两个都是引起突变的原因。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从奥斯蒂剑鱼和高额异鳍中切割获取。 可在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉奥斯蒂剑鱼、在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面捕捉高额异鳍。此外它还会从魔胎之境的感染包囊掉落。
zh.name: 饱和肌肉块

en.description:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.
en.name: Waxen Sebum Deposit

zh.description:
生物原有的体液残余物在感染后仍会存在，通常会结晶或凝结成全新的化合物。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从针刺长鳄中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴捕捉针刺长鳄。
zh.name: 蜡质皮脂沉积

en.description:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Sporulate Sac

zh.description:
这些存有感染孢子的加压储存囊需要被小心提取，否则就会炸裂并且可能造成局部污染。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从狍鸮胶蛳中切割获取。可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉狍鸮胶蛳。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和感染包囊掉落。
zh.name: 孢子液囊

en.description:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Ocular Stem-Root

zh.description:
这件在感染前曾经作为眼睛的器官仍包含有用的成分。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从须腔棘鱼中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中使用处理过的'混乱'残留物捕捉须腔棘鱼。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。
zh.name: 视觉枢干

en.description:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Parasitic Tethermaw

zh.description:
用于附在其他生命体上以供养分，并把抗凝剂和孢子注入其中。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从额叶鲤中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉额叶鲤。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。
zh.name: 寄生囊腔

en.description:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Biotic Filter

zh.description:
筛分粘性的外分泌物是生存过程中必不可少的一部分，也是对生物原有功能的一种提醒。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和韧铠灵鲷中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉韧铠灵鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和幻金英择谛罐掉落。
zh.name: 生物过滤组织

en.description:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Spinal Core Section

zh.description:
许多精巧而复杂的神经纤维被安置在有关节的脊椎骨中，这地方是生物最坚韧的部分之一。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和骨锥琼鲷中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉骨锥琼鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金和智者英择谛罐掉落。
zh.name: 脊髓核心节

en.description:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Cranial Foremount

zh.description:
在膜状蛋白层的下面，可以发现一个具有弹性、坚韧、且有着高导电性的次要'颅骨'。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从独角米索鳎中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中使用处理过的'秩序'残留物捕捉独角米索鳎。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑掉落。
zh.name: 颅骨前侧部分

en.description: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
en.name: Aquapulmo

zh.description: 这些鱼作为英择谛的 '实验'，有目的性地接受感染者感染。它们以洞穴系统中的有机沉积物为食。
zh.name: 水肺

zh.name: 水肺

en.description: Crammed with redundant, mutated internal organs, this pungent fish mingles Orokin and Infested ancestry. It is confined to the Exocrine and is only active by the light of the Wyrm Fass.
en.name: Ostimyr

zh.description: 体内挤满了多余的、变异的内脏，这种刺鼻的鱼类混有奥罗金和感染者的血统。其活动区域仅限于外分泌液，并且只有在蛟龙'混乱'的光照下才会在出现。
zh.name: 奥斯蒂剑鱼

en.description: Whatever higher functions this fish once had have been consumed, leaving it a mere automaton of metal and flesh. It ekes out a primitive existence in cave systems.
en.name: Vitreospina

zh.description: 无论这种鱼类曾经有什么更高等的功能，都已经被消耗掉了。只剩下自动化的金属和肉体。它在洞穴系统中勉强维持着原始的习性。
zh.name: 璃化脊鳎

zh.name: 璃化脊鳎

en.description: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.
en.name: Cryptosuctus

zh.description: 这些鱼类以前是奥罗金时代的清道夫，很久以前就屈从感染者了；现在贪婪地吃着漂浮的孢子。它们在火卫二的地表随处可见。
zh.name: 墓沼隐龙

en.description: As ravenous as the Infestation itself, this fish feeds on the remains of others. It shuns the light, preferring an enclosed cave environment.
en.name: Barbisteo

zh.description: 就像感染者本身一样贪婪，这种鱼类以其他同类的残骸为食。它总是避开光线，喜欢封闭的洞穴环境。
zh.name: 倒刺蒂鳌

en.description: The Infestation has suborned these fish to its own purposes, using them as antibodies to repel the non-Infested. They swim through and above the Exocrine found on Deimos’ surface.
en.name: Kymaeros

zh.description: 感染者唆使这些鱼类达成自己的目的，把它们当作抗体来对抗非感染者。它们游走于火卫二地表上的内分泌液内和其上方。
zh.name: 高额异鳍

en.description: These fish hatch out of translucent pods formed in caverns below the Infested landscape. They hover to feed.
en.name: Amniophysi

zh.description: 这些鱼类从感染地表下形成的半透明卵囊中孵化出来。它们悬游进食。
zh.name: 针刺长鳄

en.description: A muscular, three-tailed fish, the Lobotriscid trawls through Exocrine vapor across the surface of Deimos when Vome is dominant.
en.name: Lobotriscid

zh.description: 这是一种肌肉发达的三尾鱼，当'秩序'在天空中占主导地位时，三尾额叶鲤会通过外分泌雾化膜在火卫二的地面拖网捕食。
zh.name: 额叶鲤

en.description: These specimens were originally parasites, breeding inside the wyrm-guts of Fass and scattered across Deimos in the debris of his explosive demise. They are drawn to his light.
en.name: Flagellocanth

zh.description: 这些标本原本是寄生虫，在'混乱'的龙胆内繁殖，并随着其死亡喷射出的爆炸性残骸四散在了火卫二上。它们像飞蛾扑火般被'混乱'的光芒吸引着。
zh.name: 须腔棘鱼

zh.name: 须腔棘鱼

en.description: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.
en.name: Glutinox

zh.description: 这些沉重的鱼类有自相残杀的习性。它们在'秩序'的光照下出现，吸收稀有气体，当'混乱'升起时撤回，吞噬它们巢穴中相对幼小的同族。
zh.name: 狍鸮胶蛳

en.description: While the Vallis coolant has kept this finely engineered Corpus tactical boot remarkably well preserved, it is, nonetheless, entirely worthless.
en.name: Crewman’s Boot

zh.description: 虽然山谷冷却液将这精心设计的 Corpus 战靴保持得完好无缺，但它，仍没有一丝价值。
zh.name: 船员的靴子

en.description: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
en.name: Myxostomata

zh.description: 这种异常罕见的鱼种几乎要绝迹了，它那镀金的奥罗金鱼肉对掠食者来说有别具一格的味道。它小心翼翼地躲在洞穴里。
zh.name: 独角米索鳎

en.description: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
en.name: Inaak

zh.description: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。
zh.name: 载世龟

en.description: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
en.name: Xiran

zh.description: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。
zh.name: 息壤鲳

en.description: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
en.name: Haav

zh.description: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。
zh.name: 浮伤鱼

en.description: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
en.name: Namaes

zh.description: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。
zh.name: 纳土鲉

en.description: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
en.name: Seonn

zh.description: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。
zh.name: 精灵鱼

en.description: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.

en.description:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Charc Electroplax

zh.description:
被 Ostron 收割来作为合成反应的催化剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从查克鳗中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉查克鳗。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 查克放电腺体

en.description:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Goopolla Spleen

zh.description:
在 Ostron 中的偏方被用来净化毒素。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从古泊拉鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉古泊拉。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 古泊拉脾脏

en.description:
An ingredient used in Ostron cooking and medicine.

Source: Cut from Murkray fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Murkray in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots at any time of day using Murkray Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Murkray Liver

zh.description:
Ostron 用来烹饪和制药的材料。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从阴暗鳐鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋鱼点中使用阴暗鳐鱼饵捕捉阴暗鳐。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 阴暗鳐肝脏

en.description:
These will often adorn ceremonial garb or as a reagent for synthetics.

Source: Cut from Sharrac fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Sharrac in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Sharrac Teeth

zh.description:
这些常常用来装点仪式装束，或者被用来做合成的反应物。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从鲨客鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉鲨客。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 鲨客牙齿

en.description:
Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time.

Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Karkina Antenna

zh.description:
将这种物质磨成粉末可以短暂使得火烧得更旺。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从卡其那鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉卡其那。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 卡其那触须

en.description:
The bones of the Mawfish are carved by the Ostron to produce ornaments and tools.

Source: Cut from Mawfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mawfish in the Plains of Eidolon lake during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Mawfish Bones

zh.description:
喉鱼的骨骼被 Ostron 人用来制作吊饰和工具。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从喉鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉喉鱼。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 喉鱼骨骼

en.description:
The poison is used to cure leather and as a reagent to produce an embalming fluid.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

zh.description:

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从库特-库特鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉库特-库特。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 库特-库特毒囊

en.description:
Once cleaned and tanned this organ can be turned into a durable leather.

Source: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

zh.description:
一旦经过清洗和鞣制后，这种器官可以变成耐用的皮革。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从约格温鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉约格温。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 约格温鱼胃

en.description:
The Ostron boil these into a jelly which forms a strong adhesive when it dries.

Source: Cut from Tralok fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Tralok in the Plains of Eidolon ocean during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

zh.description:
Ostron 人将其煮成胶状，干燥后便成为一种强力的粘合剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从塔洛鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉塔洛。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 塔洛鱼眼

en.description:

en.description:

Source: Cut from Glappid fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Glappid in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at Night using Glappid Bait. Also drops from Thumper Bulls in the Plains of Eidolon.

zh.description:
这种厚壳被 Ostron 人用来制作工具和武器。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从盖拉佩德鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野海洋中使用盖拉佩德鱼饵捕捉盖拉佩德。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 瑟拉姆甲虫外壳

en.description:
An Ostron delicacy.

Source: Cut from Norg fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Norg in the Plains of Eidolon lake at Night using Norg Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Norg Brain

zh.description:
一种 Ostron 珍馐。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从诺格鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野湖泊中使用诺格鱼饵捕捉诺格。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 诺格鱼脑

en.description:
Ostrons extract the toxin and apply it to their weapons when hunting animals.

Source: Cut from Cuthol fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Cuthol in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots at Night. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
en.name: Cuthol Tendrils

zh.description:
Ostron 人从中提取毒素，并将之用于狩猎。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从克苏尔鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野池塘鱼点中捕捉克苏尔。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。
zh.name: 克苏尔卷须

en.description: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
en.name: Boot

zh.description: 合成纤维与注塑泡沫制成了的鞋垫，曾经它是一只强韧、舒适的战斗靴。如今，它是小型水生生物体的家。
zh.name: 靴子

en.description: You're catching a lot of these. Are you stocking up?
en.name: STOCKING

zh.description: 你捕获了很多这玩意。你是在囤货吗？
zh.name: 长袜

en.description: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
en.name: Glappid

zh.description: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。
zh.name: 盖拉佩德

en.description:
A small camera that records visual data with extremely high definition.

Source: Dismantled from Echowinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Echowinder in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather.
en.name: Echowinder Anoscopic Sensor

zh.description:
能以极高清晰度纪录影像数据的小型摄影机。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从回声环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉回声环绕者。
zh.name: 回声环绕者微孔视觉感应器

en.description:
A small, electronic brain capable of processing a billion giga-threads per second.

Source: Dismantled from Scrubber servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Scrubber in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
en.name: Scrubber Exa Brain

zh.description:
每秒能处理十亿吉字节线程的小型电子脑。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从洗涤者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉洗涤者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。
zh.name: 洗涤者艾脑

en.description:
A small, atomic power source.

Source: Dismantled from Brickie servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Brickie in Orb Vallis ponds and rivers during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
en.name: Brickie Muon Battery

zh.description:
一个小型、原子能的能源。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从砖瓦匠伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘和河流中捕捉砖瓦匠。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。
zh.name: 砖瓦匠缈子电池

names.zh: 污泥绕环者并联生物二极体

en.description:
Controls the electrical flow throughout the circuitry within robotic organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Mirewinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Mirewinder in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
en.name: Mirewinder Parallel Biode

zh.description:
控制生化机器人体内电路系统的电流。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从污泥环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉污泥环绕者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。
zh.name: 污泥绕环者并联生物二极体

en.description:
A machine element used to propel robotic organisms through coolant.

Source: Dismantled from Eye-Eye servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Eye-Eye in Orb Vallis ponds during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
en.name: Eye-Eye Rotoblade

zh.description:
一种可以让生化机器人在冷却液中推进的机器组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从目－目伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉目－目。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。
zh.name: 目－目旋翼叶片

en.description:
A weapon that discharges lasers over short distances.

Source: Dismantled from Kriller servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Kriller in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
en.name: Kriller Thermal Laser

zh.description:

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从磷虾杀手伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉磷虾杀手。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。
zh.name: 磷虾杀手热能激光器

en.description:

Source: Dismantled from Sapcaddy servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Sapcaddy in the Orb Vallis lake during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.

zh.name: 液集者维内多箱

en.description:

获取地点：赤毒虹吸任务、Taveuni（赤毒要塞）

zh.name: 交叉矩阵改造器

zh.name: 矢量线程改造器

en.name: Phasic Cells

Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

Location: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)
en.name: Somatic Fibers

从早期战甲原型采样并保存在一种稳定的脑液中的神经纤维。

获取地点：Apollo（月球）上的爆破型敌人、联结生存任务（月球）。
zh.name: 活体纤维

en.description:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
en.name: Orokin Cipher

zh.description:
这一装置可用来破解奥罗金的加密。

获取地点：通过龙钥开启过的奥罗金遗迹宝库（火卫二）
zh.name: 奥罗金破解器

An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星
zh.name: 非晶态合金

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.

获取地点：金星福尔图娜下方的深矿。

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos

获取地点：土星，海王星，阋神星和火卫二

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)

一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对夜羽和索拉里斯之声来说都是一种很有价值的商品。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）和奥布山谷（金星）中的合一众赏金任务
zh.name: 合一众塑讯块

Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers

获取地点：可在储存容器中获得

Location: Jupiter
en.name: Neural Sensors

获取地点：木星。
zh.name: 神经传感器

Location: Earth, Lua, Eris, and Deimos

获取地点：地球，月球，阋神星和火卫二

由巨人战舰动力核心所产生，这些粒子仅出现在巨人战舰活动当地或邻近的星球上。

en.name: Cryptographic Alu

zh.name: 暗号算术逻辑单元

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
en.name: Riven Sliver

破裂的裂罅 Mod 碎块。有了足够的碎块，Palladino 就可以重铸一张完整的裂罅 Mod。完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务后可在钢铁守望（地球）中找到她。

获取地点：卓越者单位、安魂遗物
zh.name: 裂罅碎块

zh.name: 裂罅熔接器

en.description:
This common plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Sunlight Threshcone

zh.description:
这种常见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光去壳毬果植物获得。
zh.name: 日光去壳毬果

en.description:
This common plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Moonlight Threshcone

zh.description:
这种常见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光去壳毬果植物获得。
zh.name: 月光去壳毬果

en.description:
This plant was introduced to arid regions across the Origin System, for its ability to collect moisture in harsh environments. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Ruk's Claw plants that grow on Mars
en.name: Ruk's Claw

zh.description:
这种植物被引进遍布于始源星系的干旱地带，储存水分的能力使其得以对抗严酷的环境。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在火星的 Ruk 之爪植物获得
zh.name: Ruk 之爪

en.description: Extracted from Skateweed.
en.name: Skateweed Extract

zh.description: 从鳐鱼草中萃取出的精华物。
zh.name: 鳐鱼草萃取物

en.description:
One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna
en.name: Vestan Moss

zh.description:
为数不多的能够在外太空小行星上繁衍生息的已知植物物种之一。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在水星、土星和赛德娜上的灶神藓植物获得
zh.name: 灶神藓

en.description: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.
en.name: Cerulean Fungus Extract

zh.description: 从蔚蓝菌群中萃取出的精华物。
zh.name: 蔚蓝菌群萃取物

en.description: Extracted from a Ghost Brush.
en.name: Ghost Brush Extract

zh.description: 从鬼影之拂中萃取出的精华物。
zh.name: 鬼影之拂萃取物

en.description:
This rare plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Sunlight Jadeleaf

zh.description:
这种稀有的植物只能在白天找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光玉叶植物获得。
zh.name: 日光玉叶

en.description:
This rare plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Moonlight Jadeleaf

zh.description:
这种稀有的植物只能在黑夜找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光玉叶植物获得。
zh.name: 月光玉叶

en.description:
This uncommon plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Sunlight Dragonlily

zh.description:
这种罕见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光龙百合植物获得。
zh.name: 日光龙百合

en.description:
This uncommon plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
en.name: Moonlight Dragonlily

zh.description:
这种罕见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光龙百合植物获得。
zh.name: 月光龙百合

en.description:
This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto
en.name: Frostleaf

zh.description:
这种坚韧不拔的植物为始源星系的寒冷地区提供了天然的食物来源。 

获取地点：通过扫采集生长在金星、海王星和冥王星上的霜叶植物获得
zh.name: 霜叶

en.description:
This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres
en.name: Dusklight Sarracenia

zh.description:
这种强壮的食虫植物已经适应了在污染水域下生存。 

获取地点：通过采集常见于谷神星，生长在 Grineer 造船厂的尘光瓶子草植物获取
zh.name: 尘光瓶子草

en.description:
This carnivorous plant can be found growing in the wilderness on Lua. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Lunar Pitcher plants that grow on Lua
en.name: Lunar Pitcher

zh.description:
这种食虫植物可以在月球的荒野之中找到。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在月球的月之猪笼草植物获得
zh.name: 月之猪笼草

en.description:
Formed over billions of years, these crystals are most often found embedded in space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
en.name: Asterite

zh.description:
这些晶体形成了数十亿年，最常被发现嵌入太空岩石中。

获取地点：航道星舰任务
zh.name: 晶状彗星碎片

en.description:
Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
en.name: Aucrux Capacitors

zh.description:
安装后，这些精致的电源系统将与 Corpus 方尖碑引起融为一体。因此，未被使用的电容器非常珍贵。 

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 奥克斯电容器

en.description: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.
en.name: Bracoid

zh.description: 一种罕见的细菌实体，可以促进感染战舰上发现的感染的扩散传播
zh.name: 孢卵菌

en.description:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
en.name: Carbides

zh.description:
用于加固绑在 Grineer 战舰上的镀金板的弹性部件。

获取地点：Grineer 船坞场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 碳化物

en.description:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua
en.name: Copernics

zh.description:
一个封装着虚空能量的单元。

获取地点：月球
zh.name: 哥白尼能量单元

en.description:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
en.name: Cubic Diodes

zh.description:
用于创建 Corpus 光子网络的重要部件。

获取地点：Corpus 冰原星球场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 立方二极管

en.description: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.
en.name: Fresnels

zh.description: 一种稀有的奥罗金材料，用于撕裂空间以安全通过虚空。
zh.name: 菲涅耳

en.description:
Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
en.name: Gallos Rods

zh.description:
为 Grineer 战舰提供动力的反物质燃料电池。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 反物质燃料棒

en.description:
A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
en.name: Isos

zh.description:
一种由纳米机器人组成并且能自我复制的液体，能够独立修复磨损和损坏的系统。

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 修复凝液

en.description: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.
en.name: Kesslers

zh.description: 用于应对太阳风的奥罗金设备。
zh.name: 太阳风导航仪

en.description:
A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
en.name: Komms

zh.description:
一块用于确保 Grineer 通信网络安全的组件。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务
zh.name: 科姆斯通讯仪

en.description:
Nullstones do not conform to several laws of physics, making them highly prized for optimizing sensitive components.

Location: Railjack Missions
en.name: Nullstones

zh.description:
虚无碎片并不符合几条重要的物理定律，因其可用于高灵敏度部件的优化而非常珍贵。

获取地点：航道星舰任务
zh.name: 虚无碎片

en.description:
A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

Location: Eris
en.name: Pustrels

zh.description:
在感染者环境中的卓越者单位经常受到的一种寄生物感染。

获取地点：阋神星
zh.name: 寄生脓疱

en.description:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions
en.name: Ticor Plate

zh.description:
用于建造攻击性战舰的高致密合金装甲板。

获取地点：航道星舰任务
zh.name: 钛核甲片

en.description:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
en.name: Titanium

zh.description:
这种柔软的金属曾被奥罗金过度开采，现在只能在太空陨石里找到。

获取地点：航道星舰任务
zh.name: 钛

en.description: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
en.name: Trachons

zh.description: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。
zh.name: 感应喉管

en.description: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
en.name: Relay Strut Component

zh.description: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。
zh.name: 中继站结构组件

en.description: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
en.name: Pyrus Essence

zh.description: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。
zh.name: 烈焰精华

en.description: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
en.name: Trembera Essence

zh.description: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于 Tenno 中继站的建造。
zh.name: 战栗精华

en.description:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
en.name: Mutagen Mass

en.description: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
en.name: Humble Beginnings

zh.description: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。
zh.name: 生于微末

en.description: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
en.name: To The City

zh.description: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。
zh.name: 前往城市

en.description: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
en.name: What Right Do They Have?

zh.description: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。
zh.name: 他们凭什么？

en.description: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
en.name: The Taking

zh.description: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。
zh.name: 巧取豪夺

en.description: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
en.name: Crawling Back

zh.description: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。
zh.name: 落魄归去

en.description: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
en.name: The Gemstone

zh.description: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。
zh.name: 智慧结晶

en.description: Money begets money.
en.name: A New Beginning

zh.description: 钱生钱。
zh.name: 璀璨新生

en.description: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
en.name: Giving Back

zh.description: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。
zh.name: 施恩谋报

en.description: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
en.name: Bury The Past

zh.description: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。
zh.name: 埋葬过去

en.description: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
en.name: A New Empire

zh.description: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。
zh.name: 帝国崛起

en.description: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
en.name: We Are Corpus

zh.description: 我们是欲望的化身。我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们，是， Corpus。
zh.name: 我们是 Corpus

zh.name: 索拉里斯食物盒装饰

zh.description: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。
zh.name: 索拉里斯食物罐装饰

names.zh: 索拉里斯餐厅托盘装饰

en.description: A meal tray for a Solaris citizen still utilizing traditional ingestion methods. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
en.name: Solaris Canteen Tray Decoration

zh.description: 仍以传统方式进食的索拉里斯市民所使用的食物托盘。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。
zh.name: 索拉里斯餐厅托盘装饰

names.zh: 索拉里斯补给货车装饰

en.description: Favored by rig jockeys for efficient transportation of parts and supplies. Give your lander that seat-of-your-pants scoundrel feel.
en.name: Solaris Supply Cart Decoration

zh.description: 受到技工的喜爱，可以有效地运输零件和补给。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加一种'老子的专属座驾'的感觉。
zh.name: 索拉里斯补给货车装饰

en.description: Off-gassed coolant can be fatal to those with organic respiratory systems. Add this decoration to your lander to evoke the smells of Fortuna.
en.name: Localized Air Purifier Decoration

zh.description: 废气中的冷却液对于有机呼吸系统是致命的。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以唤起福尔图娜的气息。
zh.name: 局部空气净化器装饰

en.description: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
en.name: Solaris Supply Rack Decoration

zh.description: 在多种甲板和污水池中常见，这种架子使得许多常用工具和零件触手可及。放置在引擎室中别有一番风味。
zh.name: 索拉里斯补给架装饰

en.description: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
en.name: Solaris Sawchain Decoration

zh.description: 可以被用于金属切割或锉修。着陆器中的实用装备。
zh.name: 索拉里斯锯条装饰

en.description: Primarily used in the opening and closing of coolant sluices. A handy addition to any lander.
en.name: Solaris Motherwrench Decoration

zh.description: 主要用于打开或关闭冷却液水闸。着陆器中的实用装备。
zh.name: 索拉里斯扳手装饰

names.zh: 索拉里斯诊断工具装饰

en.description: Useful for taking atmospheric readings and measuring the thermal properties of coolant. A handy addition to any lander.
en.name: Solaris Diagnostic Tool Decoration

zh.description: 测量大气读数和冷却液热性能时很有用。着陆器中的实用装备。
zh.name: 索拉里斯诊断工具装饰

en.description: Used by geologists, technicians, plumbers, hydrologists, terraforming engineers, slurry monitors, sumpers, crud divers... A handy addition to any lander.

zh.description: 被地质学家、技师、水管工、水文学家、地球化改造工程师、泥浆监视员、污水池操作工、污垢深潜员等等使用。着陆器中的实用装备。
zh.name: 索拉里斯采样器装饰

en.description: For when you really need that thermal prong within manipulator's reach. A handy addition to any lander.

en.description: Everything you need to refill nutrient canisters, recharge tools and protect what organics you have remaining. How you present it in your Lander is up to you.
en.name: Solaris Supplies Decoration

zh.description: 加满营养罐、工具充电、保护你剩下的有机部分，你需要的应有尽有。至于你如何将之展现在着陆器上就由你决定了。
zh.name: 索拉里斯补给装饰

zh.name: 军械库模块

zh.name: 备用 FORMA 坩埚

en.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
en.name: Landing Craft Foundry Segment

zh.description:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。
zh.name: 登陆艇铸造厂模块

en.description: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
en.name: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment

zh.description: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。
zh.name: 库娃孵化器升级模块

en.description: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
en.name: Incubator Segment

zh.description: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。
zh.name: 孵化器模块

en.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
en.name: Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment

zh.description:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天
zh.name: 照育孵化器升级模块

names.zh: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块

en.description: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
en.name: HELMINTH ARCHON SHARD SEGMENT

zh.description: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。
zh.name: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块

en.description: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
en.name: HELMINTH COALESCENT SEGMENT

zh.description: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

en.description: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
en.name: HELMINTH SEGMENT

zh.description: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。
zh.name: HELMINTH 模块

en.name: HELMINTH INVIGORATION SEGMENT

zh.description: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。
zh.name: HELMINTH 活化模块

zh.name: 春节内部装饰

en.description: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.

zh.description: 这艘像刀刃一样的登陆艇装备了地毯式轰炸空中支援系统。
zh.name: Scimitar

en.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
en.name: SKAUT

zh.description:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。
zh.name: 伺航

en.description: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
en.name: Xiphos

zh.description: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

en.description: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.

zh.description: 这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。
zh.name: Mantis

en.description: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.

zh.description: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。
zh.name: 午夜电波

en.description: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.

zh.description: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

en.description:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
en.name: TRAINING DEBT-BOND

zh.description:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
zh.name: 培训债务债券

en.description:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
en.name: SHELTER DEBT-BOND

zh.description:
涵盖从栖所租金到保险，登陆许可和支付航道船舰的所有费用。高价物品。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
zh.name: 庇护债务债券

en.description:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
en.name: MEDICAL DEBT-BOND

zh.description:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
zh.name: 医疗债务债券

en.description:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
en.name: ADVANCES DEBT-BOND

zh.description:
有时候一个技工需要一些帮助，所以他们可以预支下一次的工资。高额利率几乎可以保证他们将一辈子来偿还这笔费用。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
zh.name: 预支债务债券

en.description:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
en.name: FAMILIAL DEBT-BOND

zh.description:
上一代未付清的债务由下一代承接。努力付出偿还债务被视为一种值得的骄傲。他们有还能有什么选择？

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得
zh.name: 家族债务债券
